book.name: SUMBAOGHA
book.title: Allahri Imap So'oap Sumbaogha Sembe Musari Mome Toro Pibog Yubu

content: Allahri Abrahamag “Anme Na sembe oro aukag taplulam,” aro ambarogha (22:1-19)
Olog wameka Allahri, “'Abraham neneko Na yubu ka'ebalul to?' aro mipnun,” sembaogti, “Abraham,” yobog. Yobogpa, “Nani, na wamna,” seog.

Allahri ambarelamogti, “An me ot nhonogne an wanaagne Ishak nenekoap Moria mog so'oag pururom. Pirumundi Nari yim nhon ambatkenengeag an me 'Na sembe mhong towalengkalulam,' aro oro aukag taplulam,” aro ambarog.

Ambarogpa mabogha lukunap Abraham nenekori, “Allah sembe mhong towalengkanundi kal poa pukap,” aro kal werero sin popsinep pham keledai alibag towalengkibekti Ishakap eldi arukna phendeap Allahri ambaroghag aneko piek.
Palamek paghabog inipna phende taogpa ik wilindip sumeneko palamekti, Abrahamdi tilamogpa, Allahri leboghag aneko olog we uro wamogpa tiboghaogti,
Abraham nenekori eldi arukna phende abenekoag ambarelamsiogti, “A'un keledai aneap ane wamturom. Na nameapti Allah omekanunamdi tani yingkinemeri yanunam,” aro ambatsiog.
Ambatsiogti, “Allah sembe mhong towalengkanun” aro kal werebaekne taneko elme Ishakti sa'oag saobirogti, eldamneri auk unaap, pisoghap saelbaogpa palamdek.
Palamdekti Ishak nenekori, “Naiong,” seogpa, Abraham nenekori, “Name, sa'a?” seog. Seogpa Ishak nenekori, “Aukap kalap tomnam aghana, pham domba aukag tamnunamne tala wamla?” aro haibaog.
Haibaogpa, Abraham nenekori, “Name, Allahri tatsilenge tamnunam,” seogpa palamdek.
Palamdeka Allahri ambaroghag aneko pirekti, Abraham nenekori, “Allah sembe mhong towalengkimnun,” aro kirik yangkaogti, kal alibag pibog. Pibogti Ishak haing sae yan kaubiagha kal paliag mambirogti,
pisog kiliro “Omnun,” aro ulamogpa,
NUNI Allah Ilipsae malaikat nenekori imag agha, “Abraham, Abraham,” aro yobogpa, Abraham nenekori, “Wa,” seog.

“Wa,” seogpa, Allah arukna malaikat anekori, “Anme wali uro wamlulba, opseng kom. Andi Na sembe log uro wamlamdi yubu ka'elamnelamne wene Na eltanel. 'Anme me ot nhonogne tatnululam,' senaba o'ona aro toro piro alam kom,” seog.
Seogpa Abraham neneko tangaom agha tilamogpa, pham domba yemne pinu yagne yoabaag kekhaektangtoba wamogpa, ibogti pham aneko tolbina elme lunumna oro aukag tabog.
Taboghag aneko Abrahamdi si, “NUNI Allahri teko senenna tatsirobag,” engkaog. Engkaogha sunsunum uro wene babe nimiri lelamangdi, “NUNI Allahri yim eneag agha teko senenna tatsilul,” alamang.
Malaikat anekori nen imag agha yubu lelamogti,
“Na Nandamne Allah Siag yubu sik uro lemnunne ane: Nari, 'Anme ot nhonog agha tatnululam,' senoba, 'Name o'ona,' aro toro piro aom komba,
Nari an mikip nembagheneba, andi mangarobari mangkahyikne taneko maikno taukang. Maikno taikti, imberea nimiri a'ilbahinep kom saog uro, kirik a'angkea mag

abolag lalaptoba a'ilbanep kom saog taikpa, nimiri a'ilbahinep kom wamukang. Nimiri a'ilbahinep kom wamikpa, andi mangarobari mangkahyikne maikno taikti, nimi mog so'o wamikne oro luknulamsiikti, sindi isa nimi, sindi so'o sin ngai taikti saelbamukang.
Andi Na yubu ka'ebalamba, andi mangarobari mangkahyikne pere agha Nari nimi sisa ni tala-tala wamikne walingena tatsinun,” aro ambarog.
Ambarogpa Abraham neneko eldi arukna phende pipsioghag aneko samoro yarekba, sin ma'aptaekti, as Bersyeba pina ya'ag wamek.
Nahordi nimi liksiogne (22:20-24)

Abraham neneko ilipsae Nahorti kel Milka sembe ka'elamogpa, me linbare wamsil ana ka'ebaog. Nahorti mabo sina ane: Us me yandonge, Bus me nabinge, tanena Nahor elme wilindipne Kemuel mangaro aog. Kemuel poneko Aramnang sikini taog.
Nahor elme tomne Kesed, lamne Hazo, no'opne Pildasi, saekne Yidlap, elabome ane Betuel. Betuel ponekori Ribka mangaro aog.
Nahor elmabo tognoro pia urop kel Reumaag agha me tombare. Sina: Tebah, Gaham, Tahas apna Maakhaap likitsiog.

footnotes.text: Samenag tobogneag agha, “mag laut longorop mag abolag” tobog.
